{{Quote|And once you’re aboard, you take over and shoot everyone who gets in your way? Just the two of you?|Unidentified Rebel Major to Han Solo|<ref name="COO" />}}
This '''major''' in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was part of the Rebel force sent to the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] during a [[Battle for Poln Major|mission]]. When the [[Eastern Fleet]] of the [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] arrived in the system, the rebel team under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] deliberated on how to escape the system. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] suggested that he and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] fly into the nearby [[Golan I Space Defense Platform]] and commandeer it, which the major doubted would work.<ref name="COO" />
